title: Stabilizer Induced Module Calculation
body_html:
Stabilizer Induced Module Calculation

The evaluation map identifies the \(K_{M,+}\)-isotypic part of the induced stabilizer representation with \(S(b)^{b_C}\), and the induced module from \(S K_{M,+}\) to \(\Delta^0K_{M,0+}\) is isomorphic to the product Heisenberg-Weil representation \(\kappa_M\).
proof_html: This is the aggregate of Lemma 7.4 and Lemma 7.5. Lemma 7.4 identifies the \(K_{M,+}\)-isotypic part of the induced stabilizer representation with \(S(b)^{b_C}\) and then with the product Heisenberg-Weil type. Lemma 7.5 supplies the layer-by-layer one-dimensional Hom calculation for the Yu \(\kappa\)-factors.
